title: Patch: Cosmic Bard and Edwin Van'Spacechief glow in hand when their Combo is met, as their rows say, and Starfleet Commander, Preemptive Strike and Olivian Expanse glow when their condition holds
notes: Five newer conditional cards glow in hand exactly when playing them would take their special branch (R4189000): S+ #102 Cosmic Bard and S+ #162 Edwin Van'Spacechief once a card was played earlier this turn, the same played_earlier Combo count their Cries read, as Core #10 Rapid Replenish reads it; S #137 Starfleet Commander and S #176 Preemptive Strike while their controller has a Dormant Starship, the dormant_starship_of fact their Cries branch on; S #4 Olivian Expanse while its controller's library is empty, on the Radiant face only while it is also the only card in hand, the FREE/WINS facts shifted by one since the played card has left the hand at resolution. Each hook is a pure read of the same fact its resolution reads (R195); no state, seed, replay-hash, AI or catalog change. The added hook code moves Olivian Expanse across the complicated code-lines threshold (R1846000), so S #109 xxFreshJack and S #111 Shockwave447, which read those lists (R2173001), play differently too and are claimed here with --plays. No catalog change, so --cards is empty.

player.title: Five cards glow when their bonus is ready
changes: Cosmic Bard and Edwin Van'Spacechief glow in your hand once you have played another card this turn, when their Combo bonus is ready.
Starfleet Commander and Preemptive Strike glow in your hand while you have a Dormant Starship, when playing them would launch it.
Olivian Expanse glows in your hand while your deck is empty, when its pick would cost nothing; its Radiant face glows only while it is also the last card in hand.
Shockwave447's hand swap now treats Olivian Expanse as a complicated card.
